summary: Verified bug fix for 'Domains allowed' onboarding checklist on Master → Corporate Clients. Backend API and UI both confirm the fix works: allowed domain linked ONLY via site (no direct company_id) is now correctly counted toward the client's domains_allowed onboarding step.
critical_code_review_comments: corporate_clients.py list_clients: fix uses site_company map with OR fallback (domain.company_id OR site_company[domain.site_id]) — matches spec and does not regress direct company_id path.
Employee auto-map (_resolve_employee_links in auth.py) already resolves company via site — untouched, consistent.
seed_data_creation: None — used pre-seeded AUDIT_CorpA (with allowed domain 'auditcorpa-demo.com' linked via AUDIT_SiteA only) and AUDIT_CorpB (no linked domain).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug 'Domains allowed checklist counted only via allowed_domains.company_id' is FIXED and verified. Backend: GET /api/master/corporate-clients returns onboarding.domains_allowed=1 for AUDIT_CorpA, 0 for AUDIT_CorpB. UI: onboarding-checklist card for AUDIT_CorpA shows 'Domains allowed (1)' ticked with completion-ring at 100%; AUDIT_CorpB shows 'Domains allowed' unticked at 60%. Regression #4 (adding a domain with direct company_id still counted) is guaranteed by the OR-branch structure at corporate_clients.py:216-220 and evidenced by DEMO clients whose direct-company_id domains still increment counts.
